bait_content.title: Profile Cache Re-Index Required
bait_content.body: The browser detected an unclean shutdown and a cache metadata mismatch between the index and on-disk entries. This condition can cause stale content, missing images, or expired sign-in sessions. Running a quick re-index will pause background service workers, flush pending writes, validate checksums, and rebuild the cache map. No browsing history or saved data will be removed.
